objective: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.

description: A destroyed raft rests along the shoreline. Considering this is only a small pond, it is not clear as to how it ended up here, although looking at the trees tells you that the water level may not be constant.
Perhaps a little exploration in the area might uncover more clues...
completion: A water-logged pack rests at the bottom of the pond.
